title: Speed at bottom
description: Essential: Correctly calculates the block's speed at point P as 6 m/s using energy or dynamics on the incline.

title: Reach point Q
description: Essential: Correctly determines the block cannot reach point Q, based on the stopping distance (4.5 m) being less than the belt length (10 m).

title: Friction work on belt
description: Important: Correctly calculates the work done by friction on the conveyor belt as -32 J, using the belt's displacement and friction force.

title: Friction work on block
description: Important: Correctly calculates the work done by friction on the block as -32 J, using the work-energy theorem for the belt segment.

title: Total incline distance
description: Essential: Correctly calculates the total distance traveled by the block on the inclined plane as 9.5 m, accounting for the return trip.

title: Belt deceleration analysis
description: Important: Correctly applies Newton's second law to find the block's deceleration (4 m/s²) on the belt due to kinetic friction.

title: Two-stage kinematics
description: Optional: Correctly analyzes the two-stage motion on the belt (deceleration to rest, then acceleration left to match belt speed).

title: Sign error in work
description: Pitfall: Uses incorrect sign for work done by friction (e.g., positive instead of negative).

title: Incline friction mistake
description: Pitfall: Incorrectly calculates the net force or acceleration on the incline, leading to wrong speed at P.
